answer: Rotating earning windows stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, each agent gets one 6-hour earning window daily, and pay outside it is held 30 days. Second, windows rotate weekly, so farms cannot schedule fakes around them. Third, three windows with fake volume forfeit a $25 bond and freeze the agent 90 days. Fourth, steady agents earn longer windows, while new ones prove themselves. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 schedules, $25,000 in bonds, and $30,000 in held pay, lost if caught. Trust has a pulse, not a jade tide of endless clones, like a market stall open only on its own day.
